description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] JSON Schema validator. Validates a JSON document against a JSON Schema (draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12, formats included) and returns valid true/false with every error as a JSON Pointer, keyword and message. Input: json and schema (POST for large documents). Limits: 1 MB JSON, 200 KB schema, 100 errors listed; remote $ref is not fetched. Offline.

json.description: JSON text to validate, up to 1 MB, e.g. {"name":"Ada","age":36} (a JSON value is also accepted in a POST body or MCP arguments)

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft-07, 2019-09 or 2020-12) as JSON text or object, up to 200 KB

trial.description: Optional. true = answer free if a trial call is left (3 per IP per UTC day); otherwise you get the payment terms.

name: json_validate

_trial.description: Present when the call was a free trial call.

title: JSON Schema validator: check JSON (or LLM output) against a schema ($0.002/call)
